cases.purpose: Verify ordered cursor hide and complete reset/show controls on key exit.
cases.oracle: Documented BashOS termpixel key-read interface and raw TTY contract; ECMA-48 cursor visibility and named XTerm CSI/SS3 key codes. No external termpixel CLI is assumed.
cases.comparison: The private PTY driver captures raw output, step events and terminal modes with bounded time/output; each fixed contract predicate and natural status is checked independently in both builds.
